fal.ai

Media generation with a production workflow.

fOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Run supported image, video, and audio model APIs through fal.ai and connect generation to a clear creative brief. MoreSpace can build campaign-asset workspaces, creative variant queues, or a URL-to-video product with model selection, job tracking, and approval steps. Generated media is reviewed for brand fit, accuracy, and usage rights before it enters a publishing workflow.

Useful outputs

  • Candidate images or media clips
  • Generation metadata and job status
  • Approved exports for editing or delivery

Where we can apply it

  • Campaign brief → image variants → designer review → approved creative library.
  • Storyboard → candidate clips → editor assembly → campaign video export.
  • Product URL and approved facts → asset queue → review workspace → video package.
01

Use case 1

Build an image-generation queue from approved campaign briefs.

02

Use case 2

Create storyboard frames and candidate video clips for editing.

03

Use case 3

Develop a media-generation interface with job status and exports.

Inputs we need

  • Approved brief and reference assets
  • Selected model and output format
  • Budget and quality criteria

Delivery sequence

  • Select models against the requested media type and creative requirements.
  • Submit jobs, track status, and store assets with their source brief.
  • Review candidates and export approved versions into the production workspace.

Expert review points

  • Check visual accuracy, brand consistency, and applicable asset rights.
  • Inspect model-specific limitations before promising a production feature.
